title: Live composition refuses a canonical external scaffold admitted by the Study

evidence.reproduction: At 4ca03582, test_external_scaffold_reaches_cuda_and_metal_composition fails at the real execute_matched_from_config call with arm_environments.scaffold.path is unsafe. Read-only remote probe confirms source_reference_path admits the exact file and its frozen bytes match.

observation: Study admission and TaskPackage rendering admit canonical external scaffold files. The runtime composer applies its older source-only raw-reference resolver and refuses before any authoring turn. This is a Lab ownership mismatch, not an IR or GPU failure.
proposed_change: Opt the scaffold call into existing external_file custody checks, retaining frozen-byte verification. Keep other raw references source-only. Exercise the real CUDA and Metal composition seam plus external alias, traversal, source-checkout and changed-byte counterexamples.

verified_by.result: Original Campaign Lock scaffold resolves with frozen bytes and external custody intact under the successor. Original failed launch remains unchanged.
verified_by.scope: External scaffold composition refusal repaired; does not claim completion of the successor optimization campaign.

partial_verification.remaining: Read-only replay of original remote scaffold under the successor and new live launch.
